records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result, net sales revenue increased less than 1% in the three months ended March 31, 2022, to $12,182, compared to $12,146 in the same period last year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Core brand gross billing increased by 3% to $13,287 compared to $12,955 during the same period last year, driven by Reed’s volume growth of 5% offset by Virgil’s volume decline of 11%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The sales growth focus is on channel expansion, new product introduction and improved sales execution.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the first quarter of 2022, the Company continued to strengthen its supply chain, implement gross margin enhancement initiatives, drive efficiencies in transportation and warehouse costs and reduce operating expenses.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The margin enhancement initiative is driven by co-packer upgrades, better leveraged purchasing and improved efficiency.
